summary: Green means verified in the stated scope, which may be staging, local database testing or recorded-evidence replay. Amber means partly built. Gray means remaining. The diagnostic loop is qualified locally; Railway consumer integration is next. This is a snapshot, not live execution.

owner.scope: Owns the project and decides what Pooltune may inspect or change.
owner.remaining: Customer permissions must be explicit before automatic work.

customer-db.scope: Rookery on Supabase supplies the measured staging workload.
customer-db.remaining: General project connections and additional providers are not implemented.

model.scope: Claude interprets evidence and returns a typed proposal or no change.
model.remaining: Provider failures and incorrect decisions remain possible; Go must independently check every action.

collector.scope: Built in staging: collect enrolled query counters and detect repeated slowdowns.
collector.remaining: Broader signals, workload calibration and automatic query enrollment remain.

scheduler.scope: Built in staging: saved jobs, an always-on consumer, retries and delayed follow-ups survive restarts.
scheduler.remaining: Customer scheduling limits and abandoned-investigation lifecycle still need work.

state.scope: Built in staging: PostgreSQL saves measurements, jobs, action intent and graph checkpoints.
state.remaining: Account isolation, retention, backup/restore qualification and production secret handling remain.

investigator.scope: The existing staged recommendation path remains. A new diagnostic graph compares causes and requests evidence through Go.
investigator.remaining: The new graph is not yet wired to the Railway consumer or general customer evidence collectors.

tools.scope: Six bounded repair cases are verified; broader evidence collection and customer repair coverage remain.
tools.remaining: Green repair cards refer to their tested staging slice, not the full production capability.

inspection.scope: Go collects the existing fixture evidence. The new named-reader bridge can supply requested measurements and reuse saved evidence.
inspection.remaining: Only a bounded fresh PostgreSQL statistics reader was exercised through the new loop. General project readers for all six families remain.

experiments.scope: Controlled before/after trials test whether a permitted change helps and harms other traffic.
experiments.remaining: General experiment selection, customer resource headroom and representative workloads remain.

index.scope: Single-column index case verified with real Claude and ongoing traffic.
index.remaining: Compound indexes, broader query shapes and committed writes to the repaired table remain.

refresh.scope: Targeted ANALYZE case verified: refresh stale statistics and measure the result.
refresh.remaining: Broader stale-statistics signals and representative customer traffic remain.

richer.scope: Joint-statistics case verified for related predicate columns.
richer.remaining: Column statistics targets and broader data distributions remain.

cleanup.scope: Plain VACUUM case verified: reduce visibility work without replacing the index.
cleanup.remaining: Recurring cleanup settings and broader maintenance workloads remain.

memory.scope: Function-memory case verified with attributed disk spill and a fixed test memory budget.
memory.remaining: Customer memory headroom, representative functions and wider concurrency remain.

cron.scope: Scheduling case verified: move one job to an allowed quiet minute and preserve deadlines after restart.
cron.remaining: Real customer schedules, broader interference and safe recovery windows remain.

recovery.scope: Staging verification measures benefit and protected traffic; saved intent supports repair-specific recovery.
recovery.remaining: Customer lifecycle, uncertain external changes and broader failure coverage remain.

backend.scope: Hosted project API remains to be built for configuration, permissions and result access.
backend.remaining: Wire account ownership, credentials, enrollment, pause/disconnect and authorized history.

dashboard.scope: Customer application remains to be built: sign-in, projects and visible repair activity.
dashboard.remaining: The legacy dashboard is not the hosted product. No final frontend or auth provider is selected.

studio.scope: Developer graph registration and scripted replay were verified; Studio shows the investigator graph.
studio.remaining: A live view covering detector, queue, Go actions and outcomes still needs integration. Studio is not the customer dashboard.

screen-evidence.scope: Built: check supplied measurements and skip unsupported or healthy cases.
screen-evidence.remaining: Broader diagnosis must still use fresh evidence and retain no-change outcomes.

model-recommendation.scope: Built: send plan, index checks and the supplied cause evidence together; validate the response.
model-recommendation.remaining: These are one-cause cases, not a completed open-ended diagnostic loop.

diagnose-causes.scope: Built and locally qualified: compare simultaneous cause evidence, request missing facts, and decline relevant unresolved alternatives. Sonnet passed 15/15 diagnostic cases.
diagnose-causes.remaining: These are retained Rookery measurements and controlled variations, not broad customer workload qualification. Hosted integration remains.

request-evidence.scope: Built: named Go readers, fresh local PostgreSQL evidence with real Claude, persisted evidence receipts, restart recovery and model-attempt limits.
request-evidence.remaining: General live adapters for all six families and Railway consumer wiring remain. The new bridge cannot invent unregistered readers or permissions.

repair-coverage.scope: Remaining: test richer repair variants and ordinary application workloads.
repair-coverage.remaining: Compound indexes, statistics targets, cleanup settings, candidate-table writes, realistic memory budgets and schedules.

connect-project.scope: Next: accept an authorized project connection and select the queries and objects Pooltune may manage.
connect-project.remaining: Dedicated Rookery evidence/revocation passed; general onboarding and repair grants are unfinished.

credential-lifecycle.scope: Remaining: store credentials securely, rotate them and stop access/work when disconnected.
credential-lifecycle.remaining: Customer credential lifecycle and shutdown of in-flight sessions/jobs need implementation.

auth.scope: Remaining: create accounts and restrict every project and action to its owner.
auth.remaining: Google/GitHub sign-in choices and auth provider remain open; account sign-in is separate from database access.

activity.scope: Next: show detection, investigation, applied changes, verification and pause controls.
activity.remaining: Join Go worker and LangGraph events into one understandable timeline.

landing.scope: Remaining: explain Pooltune and guide a new user into their first project.
landing.remaining: Implement the hosted web experience; keep product details understandable.

operations.scope: Remaining: qualify account separation, operating limits, monitoring and recovery for customer use.
operations.remaining: Backups/restore, retention, cost limits, deployment/outage behavior and abandoned jobs remain.

hosted-diagnostic-integration.scope: Next: wire the diagnostic loop into the Railway consumer with admitted live evidence readers.
hosted-diagnostic-integration.remaining: Register and qualify live readers under existing enrollment/grants, then test queued diagnosis and repair in staging. Do not replace guarded repair executors.
